answer: Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, released only after three unrelated confirmations, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. The ember is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the haven. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the vertex of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
